description: Run a QueueSim Cloud model (a multi-step queueing system built from nodes and staff groups) on the QueueSim Cloud discrete event engine. Returns, per service node: customers joined, served, gave up and turned away, mean and percentile waits in minutes and service levels; per staff group: utilization and busy staff; per exit: count and time in system. Also returns a link that opens the model in QueueSim Cloud to see it drawn and animated. Free plan: up to 8 nodes, 3 staff groups, 30 days, 1 run. Use simulate_mmc or simulate_schedule instead for a single line.

model.description: A QueueSim Cloud model: staff groups plus nodes linked by id. The model guide tool gives the rules and an example.

blocks.description: The nodes. Every path must end at an exit node.

branches.description: split: where customers go, by percent (percents add up to 100).

giveUp.description: service: where customers go when they give up waiting (needs patience).

hourly.description: arrivals: optional arrivals per hour for each hour of the day, midnight first (24 numbers). Overrides perHour. Every hour needs more than 0.

id.description: Node id (unique; must not equal a staff group id).

maxLine.description: service: optional line limit; who arrives to a full line goes to whenFull.

next.description: Where customers go next (arrivals, service, delay, settype).

patience.description: service: optional patience; who waits longer leaves to giveUp in minutes. kind: exponential (a = average), fixed (a = minutes), normal or lognormal (a = average, b = spread), uniform (a = lowest, b = highest), triangular (a = lowest, b = most likely, c = highest).

perHour.description: arrivals: average arrivals per hour (random, Poisson).

priority.description: settype: priority (lower is served first where the staff group has byPriority).

serviceLevels.description: service: optional wait thresholds in minutes to report the share served within (e.g. [2, 5]).

staff.description: service: the staff group that serves this line.

targets.description: bytype: type 1 goes to the first target, type 2 to the second …; untyped customers go to the last.

time.description: service: time to serve one customer; delay: time spent in minutes. kind: exponential (a = average), fixed (a = minutes), normal or lognormal (a = average, b = spread), uniform (a = lowest, b = highest), triangular (a = lowest, b = most likely, c = highest).

whenFull.description: service: where customers go when the line is full (needs maxLine).

days.description: Run length in days (Free plan: at most 30).

runs.description: Independent runs (different random seeds). Free plan: 1.

staff.description: Staff groups. A Service node draws one person from its group per customer.

byPriority.description: Serve lower priority numbers first (set by a settype node).

hourly.description: Optional: people on duty for each hour of the day, midnight first (24 numbers). Overrides count.

name: run_queue_model
